messages:
mike_ae: Heads-up  PegasusHealth wants a 4-week POC to validate embeddings + answer-with-sources for their clinical support KB. Procurement asked for a single scoping doc and security artefacts.

amy_se: Thanks. Can we capture their primary flows and acceptance criteria so SE/product can map models and perf targets?

jordan_cust: PegasusHealth flows: 1) semantic KB search (avg doc ~1.2k tokens), 2) short, attributed answers (must include source link + section), 3) triage classifier prompts for routing to clinicians vs. auto-response. UX target: ~200-300ms median for short replies. Not high QPS for POC, but they want a throughput/headroom demo.

tom_sa: Suggested POC stack: 1024-d embeddings into a hosted vector index (demo), r/instruct-6b-quant for generation (latency/cost sweet spot). We'll provision a small Dedicated-like staging pool and provide perf estimates. Expect median generation ~150-300ms depending on network.

sara_sec: Security checklist (POC baseline): redacted SOC2 Type II summary + controls mapping, DPA draft + SCC guidance for EU flows, subprocessors list, encryption (KMS/HSM), TLS, optional VPC/PrivateLink for connectivity, retention policy defaults, redaction rules, and pen-test scoping. HIPAA: confirm PHI scope before ingest.

beth_legal: I'll upload our DPA template and SCC guidance. Need customer confirmation: will PegasusHealth act as EU controller? Also need clarity on whether PHI will be included in the POC dataset.

jordan_cust: There will be EU patients in the KB and a small subset of notes that could be PHI. They want a pre-ingestion compliance check and to keep PHI out of hosted demo until approved.

amy_se: Action items I captured: (1) Legal: DPA + subprocessors export; (2) Security: SOC2 summary + controls mapping; (3) Infra: pen-test policy + staging org + log retention defaults; (4) SE/Product: POC success criteria + eval prompt matrix. Ill draft a one-page scoping doc.

tom_sa: Draft POC success criteria (proposal): - Top-5 search recall >= 89% on their 300-sample eval set - Citation precision >= 90% when model emits a source - Median generation latency <= 250ms for responses <= 128 tokens - Cost estimate per 1k tokens and comparison to their current baseline - Demonstrate VPC connectivity and audit log export to their SIEM

sara_sec: Pen-test guidance: we permit customer-run, non-destructive tests on the isolated POC org under NDA and signed scope. Need 10 business days notice. All findings must be submitted to our security triage before external disclosure. Explicitly disallowed: attacks on multi-tenant control plane, attempts to access other customers, destructive or data-exfil attempts.

beth_legal: IP/data ownership: standard terms apply  customer owns inputs and generated outputs. Logs needed for ops/troubleshooting are retained short-term; any longer retention must be negotiated in the DPA.

finance_ops: Pricing question: for a 4-week POC we usually offer a capped usage credit. Recommend $10k credit to cover infra and SE time. If they want a short Dedicated baseline we can offer an invoice credit. Finance to confirm.

tom_sa: For evals we'll request: (a) 300 search queries + ground-truth doc ids, (b) 150 answer prompts labeled for correctness + expected citations, (c) traffic profile (seq length distribution). We'll run our eval harness and return a Notebook + summary report.

jordan_cust: I'll assemble the datasets and mark records that may contain PHI for legal/security review. ETA: datasets ready in 6 business days (target: next Tue).

sara_sec: Data retention defaults for POC: logs 7 days, audit events 30 days. We can provide continuous log export to their SIEM or S3 if they want longer retention for compliance. For PHI we recommend not ingesting into hosted demo until contractual addendum.

deploy-bot: staging org created: pegasus-poc-20260411 (owner: mike_ae). Request id poc-pegasus-20260411.

amy_se: Scheduling: propose Fri 9am PT alignment meeting (Eng, Security, Legal, Finance + PegasusHealth). I'll send the invite and post the one-pager draft before EOD tomorrow.

mike_ae: Procurement also asked for a SOC2 one-page they can attach to the internal purchase request. Sara, can you prepare a controls mapping (availability, confidentiality, incident response) and a redacted SOC2 summary by Thurs COB?

sara_sec: Yes  will prepare controls mapping and redacted summary. Also will draft the pen-test scoping template for customer use.

beth_legal: Uploading DPA + subprocessors list shortly. Full SOC2 report requires NDA; we'll offer a redacted summary to procurement and a controls mapping for their reviewers.

amy_se: I'll consolidate legal/security/SE artifacts into a single POC one-pager and post here after the alignment meeting. Thanks team :thumbsup:
